description: This Java class defines a Fragment (LogFragment) that displays log data within an Android application. It manages creating views such as a ScrollView containing a custom LogView, handles layout and padding, and updates the view when the log text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays log messages using a custom LogView inside a ScrollView, handling view creation, layout, and text updates.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, padding, and gravity, returning the root ScrollView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy for the fragment, sets a TextWatcher to auto-scroll the LogView to the bottom when text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used in the fragment for logging purposes.
